ui.intro: Run a check to see how connections, folders and tools are doing.
ui.askFix: Ask the assistant to fix it
ui.askFixPrompt_one: Doctor found {{count}} problem: {{list}}. Please help me fix it.
ui.askFixPrompt_other: Doctor found {{count}} problems: {{list}}. Please help me fix them.

config_invalid: The settings file has a problem
folders_not_set: The downloads folder or a library folder is not set
folders_not_writable_one: Reelix cannot write to {{count}} library folder
folders_not_writable_other: Reelix cannot write to {{count}} library folders
folders_ok_one: The downloads folder and {{count}} library folder are ready
folders_ok_other: The downloads folder and {{count}} library folders are ready
hardlink_no_sample: Not tested: there is no downloaded file to test with yet
hardlink_needs_library: Needs a library folder that exists
hardlink_cross_device_one: The downloads and {{count}} library folder are on different file systems
hardlink_cross_device_other: The downloads and {{count}} library folders are on different file systems
hardlink_denied_one: Reelix may not link downloaded files into {{count}} library folder
hardlink_denied_other: Reelix may not link downloaded files into {{count}} library folders
hardlink_failed_one: A hard link into {{count}} library folder failed
hardlink_failed_other: Hard links into {{count}} library folders failed
hardlink_unreadable: Hard links work, but downloaded files are readable only by their owner
hardlink_ok_one: Hard links from the downloads work in {{count}} library folder
hardlink_ok_other: Hard links from the downloads work in all {{count}} library folders
downloader_path_unseen: {{name}} saves to {{folder}}, which Reelix cannot see
media_server_missing: No plugin provides the media server {{name}}
media_server_unseen_one: {{name}} has no library for {{count}} of Reelix's folders
media_server_unseen_other: {{name}} has no library for {{count}} of Reelix's folders
free_space_unknown: Free space is unknown: the downloads folder is not set
free_space_low: Only {{free}} free at the downloads folder
tmdb_ok_proxy: TMDB answers through the proxy in {{ms}} ms
plugins_need_server: Plugins are checked only while the server runs

impact.no_filing: Finished downloads cannot be filed into the library.
impact.server_may_not_read: The media server may not be able to read them.
impact.downloader_off: Nothing can be downloaded until {{name}} works.
impact.media_server_off: Filing into the library continues; play links, watch history, “For you” suggestions and the library refresh of {{name}} are off.
impact.downloads_not_found: Finished downloads cannot be found, so they are not filed.
impact.media_server_unseen: New films and episodes in those folders do not appear in {{name}}, and their play links do not work.
impact.no_ffprobe: Videos cannot be inspected for resolution, HDR, audio and subtitle tracks. Nothing stands in.
impact.no_ffmpeg: Frames cannot be taken from videos, and subtitles inside a video cannot be read for translation. Nothing stands in.
impact.no_7z: RAR and 7z subtitle archives cannot be unpacked. ZIP archives and plain subtitle files still work.
impact.config_defaults: Reelix uses its default settings until the file is fixed.
impact.loopback: Reelix cannot reach that service at this address.
impact.space_low: Large downloads may stop or be refused.
impact.tmdb_off: Titles, posters and descriptions cannot be looked up.
impact.root_files: Files Reelix writes belong to root, so your downloader and media server may not be able to change them.

actions.set_path_map: Set how its folders look to Reelix

folder.no_sample: Not tested: no downloaded file to test with yet
folder.link_cross_device: On a different file system from the downloads
folder.link_denied: Reelix may not link files here
folder.server_not_needed: {{server}} does not need to see the downloads
folder.server_unseen: No library of {{server}} holds this folder

downloader_other_folder: {{name}} saves to {{folder}} and Reelix has {{ours}}, but its finished downloads are not there: the two are different folders. Say in the path map where {{name}}'s folder is here.
